claim_boundary: Exact PSD selected-excess and conductor-pinching inequalities, fixed-ray class-average compression, and a raw-L2 consequence only. No selected primitive Guth--Maynard-shaped cubic estimate, Hecke large-value theorem, density theorem, detector, or prime-ideal theorem is proved.

contained_no_go.finite_witness: The Z/2 class-average check has local height multiplicity one and minimum coloured energy six, but selected excess 144 while averaged-block excess is zero.
contained_no_go.non_overclaim: These are finite algebraic countermodels, not P7 zero, detector, or large-value examples and do not exclude another character-aware method.
contained_no_go.statement: Within the abstract selected Gram class, PSD positivity, a raw L2 operator bound, coloured energy, and local height multiplicity alone do not control the selected cubic excess.
contained_no_go.weakest_route_specific_statistics: For the PSD route: the centred Gram variance V2 together with Lambda. For the class-average route: delta_3, or the stronger checkable delta_2.

correction.affected_claim: Only the aggregate-sign wording and the need for a separately signed cross-conductor triangle estimate are corrected. The lack of a common ray group and the need for a quantitative global Gram bound remain.
correction.cause: The aggregate trace difference was not subjected to PSD block pinching before it was described.
correction.defect: The predecessor described the aggregate X_cross=tr(K^3)-sum_f tr(K_f^3) as generally signed. Individual block-expansion summands can be signed, but the aggregate is nonnegative for every PSD K.
correction.repair: PSD pinching proves 0<=X_cross<=G(K); the upper bound retains the global selected diagonal subtraction.
correction.rerun: The exact Fraction-only finite checks below and the focused builder/test replay verify the correction.

cross_conductor_pinching.definition: X_cross(K)=tr(K^3)-sum_f tr(K_f^3), with K_f the exact-conductor principal blocks.

finite_sharpness_check.matrix: J_R with one selected row in each conductor block
finite_sharpness_check.sharpness: X_cross=G(K)=R^3-R; the upper inequality is exact.

cross_conductor_pinching.individual_term_warning: Individual expansion terms with several conductor labels can be signed; this does not make the aggregate X_cross signed.
cross_conductor_pinching.lower_bound: 0<=X_cross by Schatten-3 contractivity of the block pinching E(K)=direct_sum_f K_f.
cross_conductor_pinching.upper_bound: X_cross<=G(K), because X_cross=G(K)-sum_f G(K_f)+R[(sum_f p_f mu_f)^3-sum_f p_f mu_f^3] and Jensen makes the bracket nonpositive.

fixed_ray_class_average_compression.definitions: C_bar=H^-1 sum_g C_g, Delta_g=C_g-C_bar, A=P_W U^*(direct_sum_g C_g)U P_W, A_0=P_W(I_X tensor C_bar)P_W, delta_3=(sum_g||Delta_g||_S3^3)^(1/3).

Applying the P7-2 primitive L2 theorem to this complete-character identity would additionally require conductor-safe complete-to-primitive transfer and difference sampling.

fixed_ray_class_average_compression.missing_input: A source-scale ideal-class distribution/Poisson estimate for delta_3 or delta_2, plus a common averaged-block cubic estimate.
fixed_ray_class_average_compression.selection_decomposition: A_0=direct_sum_{chi in X} C_bar restricted to T_chi; it contains no completion factor kappa_f(W).
fixed_ray_class_average_compression.setup: At one modulus f, U(MM*)U*=H direct_sum_{g in Cl(f)} C_g. P_W is the exact primitive selected-row projector; no projector signs or zero extensions are altered.
fixed_ray_class_average_compression.trace_preservation: tr(A)=tr(A_0), since the ray-class diagonal of U P_W U^* is |A_t|/H and sum_g Delta_g=0.

sampled_l2_consequence.large_sieve_scale: L_{N,Q,T}=(1+log^2(2N))(2N+4Q^2(T+1)^2)(log(2Q(T+1)))^A up to the checked K-dependent source constant.
sampled_l2_consequence.operator_and_variance: Lambda(K)<<_K L_{N,Q,T}, tr(K^2)<<_K L_{N,Q,T}tr(K), and G(K)<<_K 3L_{N,Q,T}(L_{N,Q,T}tr(K)-tr(K)^2/R).
sampled_l2_consequence.sampling: Unit-interval Sobolev sampling and disjoint intervals within each character fibre multiply the continuous source L2 bound by at most 1+log^2(2N).
sampled_l2_consequence.scope: For tr(K) asymptotic to RN and N<=T^C, this is T^o(1)RN(N+Q^2T^2)^2. It is a raw-L2 fallback, not the Guth--Maynard refined S3 shape.
sampled_l2_consequence.sharp_raw_l2_barrier: The rank-one J_R check saturates tr(K^2)=Lambda(K)tr(K) and has G(K)=R^3-R; raw L2 data alone supplies no fixed R-saving.
